delivery.outcome: _scan_serve_processes in src/koruapi/opencode_terminals.py drops from cyclomatic complexity 22 to below the code2llm limit 15 by extracting behavior-preserving module-level helpers (_read_cmdline, _is_opencode_serve, _parse_serve_listen_args, _to_int) that keep the exact original guard order, argv matching and --port/--hostname parsing semantics. New tests/test_opencode_serve_scan.py pins the extracted helpers and the end-to-end /proc scan behavior; no public API, registry semantics, or discovery result shape changes.
nonGoals: Changing any observable discovery result, id/url/label format, or default host 127.0.0.1
Reducing the other reported hotspots in the module or elsewhere — separate tickets
Renaming or removing any public name

architecture.decision: Split the monolithic _scan_serve_processes into single-responsibility private module functions (cmdline reading with NUL filtering, opencode-serve argv matching, listen-argument parsing, int coercion); the original function keeps only /proc iteration and result assembly so behavior is equivalent.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the original single _scan_serve_processes body is restored verbatim.
